headline.purpose: Section h2, the most reused size.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: On-screen movement: hero photo wipe, product morph.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Button press scale(0.97) and color changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Signal Red CTA, 2px radius, used for Cere ofertă.
components.css: .ds-btn-red { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:3rem; padding:0.625rem 1.5rem; border-radius:2px; background:#d6001a; color:#fff; font-weight:600; line-height:1.2; text-decoration:none; transition:background-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-red:hover { background:#b00015; } .ds-btn-red:active { transform:scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-red:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #fff; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Line Button
components.description: Outlined phone action on ink surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-line { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:3rem; padding:0.625rem 1.5rem; border-radius:2px; border:1.5px solid currentColor; background:#14171c; color:#fff; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; transition:background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-line:hover { background:#232930; } .ds-btn-line:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #fff; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Field
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:0.375rem; } .ds-field label { font-weight:600; font-size:0.95rem; color:#14171c; } .ds-field input { min-height:3rem; padding:0.625rem 0.875rem; border:1.5px solid #8a94a3; border-radius:2px; background:#fff; color:#14171c; font:inherit; font-size:1rem; transition:border-color 140ms ease; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color:#14171c; outline:3px solid #d6001a; outline-offset:0; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Header link with a red underline drawn on hover, full on the current page.
components.html: ProduseServicii
components.css: .ds-nav { background:#14171c; padding:0 1rem; display:flex; gap:1.5rem; } .ds-navlink { position:relative; display:inline-block; padding:1.2rem 0; color:#fff; font-weight:500; text-decoration:none; } .ds-navlink::after { content:''; position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:0.55rem; height:2px; background:#ff0019; transform:scaleX(0); transform-origin:left; transition:transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-navlink[aria-current='page']::after, .ds-navlink:hover::after { transform:scaleX(1); }

components.name: Hex Badge
components.description: Numbered hexagon, the signature shape, for services.
components.css: .ds-hex { display:inline-grid; place-items:center; width:3.25rem; height:3.75rem; background:#d6001a; color:#fff; font-size:0.95rem; font-weight:650; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; clip-path:polygon(50% 0,100% 25%,100% 75%,50% 100%,0 75%,0 25%); }

components.name: Hex Note
components.description: Fact row with a hexagon bullet; replaces side-stripe borders.
components.css: .ds-note { display:flex; gap:0.75rem; align-items:baseline; background:#fff; color:#14171c; padding:0.75rem 1rem; } .ds-note::before { content:''; flex:none; width:0.6rem; height:0.7rem; background:#ff0019; clip-path:polygon(50% 0,100% 25%,100% 75%,50% 100%,0 75%,0 25%); }

components.name: Capacity Axis
components.description: Log-scale bar on ink with 2px baseline and ticks.
components.css: .ds-axis { position:relative; height:2.5rem; border-bottom:2px solid #333b45; background:#14171c; } .ds-bar { position:absolute; bottom:-2px; left:20%; width:45%; height:1.25rem; background:#ff0019; }

narrative.overview: A technical supplier's site that reads like a well-labelled control panel: a dark ink frame (header, hero, capacity scale, quote band, footer) around pale working surfaces, one signal red, square corners, hexagon marks and real numbers. The ink frame exists because the client's logo is a white raster; content sits on paper and white. This is a deliberate single-theme deviation, not a dark mode.
keyCharacteristics: One accent (logo red), used for actions, marks and the progress line only.
Ink bands alternate with paper and white bands.
Geist only; weight and size carry hierarchy, tabular figures for every number.
Sharp geometry: 2px controls, 0 elsewhere, hexagon as the single signature shape.
Flat surfaces, no shadows; depth comes from tonal bands.
Motion is CSS only and always inside prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Red is the only chromatic color. Use Logo Red for marks and Signal Red wherever text or a fill must meet contrast; never use Logo Red as a white-text button fill.

rules.name: The Ink Frame Rule
rules.body: Anything that shows the logo or opens the page (header, hero, footer) is ink because the logo is white. Content bands are paper or white.

rules.name: The Tabular Number Rule
rules.body: Every figure uses .num (tabular-nums). Headings use text-wrap: balance, paragraphs text-wrap: pretty.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: Do not add shadows; separate with band color or a hairline.

rules.name: The Only Hexagon Rule
rules.body: The hexagon is the sole decorative shape; no circles, pills, blobs or rounded cards.

dos: Do keep logo-bearing surfaces on Plant Ink (#14171c) and content on Paper (#f3f5f7) or White.
Do use Signal Red (#d6001a) for every white-text fill and red text; Logo Red (#ff0019) for marks and large type on ink.
Do end every page with the quote band or the action bar so "Cere ofertă" and the phone number stay one click away.
Do draw figures from content/site.ts and set them with .num.
Do wrap every animation in prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference and keep CSS-only.
Do mark unconfirmed client claims visibly instead of presenting them as fact.
donts: Don't add a second accent color, gradients, or shadows.
Don't round anything beyond the 2px control radius or introduce shapes other than the hexagon.
Don't add a second typeface, serif, or mono.
Don't use side-stripe borders for emphasis; use the hexagon note instead.
Don't add carousels, marquees or animation libraries.
